title: Sakana-tachi wa Koi o Shiranai
titleJp: 魚たちは恋を知らない
tagline: The Tides of Youth and the Mysteries of the Sea
summary: A high school romance set along a sunlit coastal port town, following a solitary fish nerd and marine biology fanatic whose comfortable rhythm among harbor fishermen and tide pools is thrown into turmoil by the unpredictable currents of youth and first love.
